$comment: The product's name, in one place (docs/research/app-name-injection.md). `pnpm run brand:sync` writes every generated brand module from this file; `pnpm run rename-app -- "<New Name>"` edits it and runs the sync. `name` and `repository` are display values: everything that shows the name follows them. `identity` holds the values already written to narrators' machines and projects: they do NOT follow a rename, and changing one needs a migration like src/studio/desktop/internal/legacyname. `retiredNames` are names the product had before; the name guard fails on them outside the migration files.
name: Narration Studio
